item.title: With a new Chicago Bears stadium possible, what's next for Hammond, Indiana?
item.description: Indiana lawmakers have approved an amendment to Senate Bill 27, naming Hammond as the official site for a new Chicago Bears stadium, with the team committing to contributing $2 billion towards construction and the state providing $1 billion in public funding through various taxes and tolls.

item.title: Meet the only Joffrey Ballet dancer from Chicago
item.description: Evan Boersma is the only Chicago-born member of the Joffrey Ballet, a world-renowned dance company featuring talent from around the world, and he credits his success to his passion for dance and the training he received at the Chicago Academy for the Arts.

item.title: Is Arlington Heights still in play for the Chicago Bears?
item.description: The Chicago Bears may be moving to Hammond, Indiana, as the Indiana House Ways and Means Committee passed a bill naming Hammond as the location for a new Bears stadium, while the Illinois lawmakers are still in the process of passing two bills that would provide the Bears with a major property tax value reduction and taxpayer funding for infrastructure upgrades.
